name: mcpie
description: Order your usual Domino's: dry-run freely, place only on explicit confirmation. Cash at pickup, no card data ever.
long_description: The standing-order pizza button. Define your usual order once in ~/.config/mcpie/config.toml (see the repo's config.example.toml), then Claude can check the store, list coupons, price the order — and place it only after you explicitly say so. Payment is always cash at pickup/delivery; no card data exists anywhere in this package. Unofficial Domino's API, US/Canada only, must run from a residential connection (automatic when running locally). Requires uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/).

config_path.title: Config file path
config_path.description: Path to your mcpie config TOML (leave default unless you keep it elsewhere)
